paths.title: Newcomer: Java and robot basics
paths.description: Build programming vocabulary, practice small Java programs, and follow information and power through a robot. Time is an approximate self-paced estimate.
outcomes: Explain variables, branching, loops, methods, and classes
Compile and check small Java programs
Trace a robot command from operator input to mechanism

paths.title: Robot programmer: commands and mechanisms
paths.description: Connect command-based architecture, a simulated intake, scheduler behavior, and a real Team 1257 code trace. Time is an approximate self-paced estimate.
outcomes: Build or trace a command-based intake in simulation
Distinguish robot code from evidence of deployed behavior

paths.title: Controls, localization, and autonomous
paths.description: Connect sensors and feedback to motion, drivetrain coordinates, paths, and recorded data. Time is an approximate self-paced estimate.
outcomes: Interpret encoder units, control error, and motion constraints
Predict swerve motion and explain odometry uncertainty
Trace a real autonomous selection and investigate a real log without overstating it

paths.title: Team integration: build, investigate, and communicate
paths.description: Bring electrical, mechanical, programming, strategy, and safety perspectives into a shared review. Time is an approximate self-paced estimate.
outcomes: Map power, signals, and mechanism interfaces
Develop a safe troubleshooting and test plan
Report observations, uncertainty, and decisions across subteams
